title: Government College University Hyderabad Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Government College University Hyderabad Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XLVII OF 2018
ACT XLVII OF 2018
GOVERNMENT COLLEGE UNIVERSITY HYDERABAD (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Government College University Hyderabad Act, 2018
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th June, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-29/2018,
dated 7.6.2018.---The Government
College University Hyderabad (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th May, 2018 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 5th June, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Government
College University Hyderabad Act, 2018, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Government College University Hyderabad (Amendment) Act,
2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
